workItems.title: Maintain the mobile-clean 2D shipping baseline

Production claims remain tied to exact reviewed source and route-aware acceptance.

workItems.title: Complete the World Identity visual maintenance lane

acceptanceCriteria: World Identity changes remain isolated from accepted navigation and teleport ownership.
Motion, reduced-motion, layout, and render contracts remain deterministic and test-backed.
Any publication or production action stays behind its own exact lifecycle boundary.

workItems.title: Plan the native app-store wrapper after web stabilization

acceptanceCriteria: System back behavior maps to the existing one-overlay-at-a-time contract.
Safe-area, orientation, and device input behavior match the verified web baseline.
Store packaging begins only after privacy, metadata, screenshot, and parity gates are explicit.

workItems.description: Move Mazer production to the master project while preserving progression, identities, receipts, and the exact legacy rollback source.
acceptanceCriteria: Master binding is exact.

acceptanceCriteria: Authorization uses PKCE and an exact redirect.

workItems.title: Establish one deterministic app-icon authority

acceptanceCriteria: One master artwork remains authoritative.
Generated derivatives are deterministic.
Maskable assets preserve the complete safe geometry.

workItems.title: Harden PWA installability and delivery assets

acceptanceCriteria: Manifest and metadata reference generated assets.

acceptanceCriteria: Transfer timing is phase-aware and pause-safe.

acceptanceCriteria: Domain and legacy adapters preserve their declared topology semantics.
